decision.authority: owner d1b9f3c0 / correction7d8d831e; worker w4 first homepage review
decision.rationale: The official Forestry-hosted Malcolm Knapp Research Forest homepage describes a longstanding research site and useful public programming, partnership opportunities, event announcements and trail guidance. No same-name host occurs in the current published host index. Research is the institutional default, with evidenced opportunities, news, support and outdoor-learning overrides; the homepage does not establish an exclusively Okanagan mandate.
evidence: https://www.mkrf.forestry.ubc.ca/ | 9f6445827707363e96489ec15c643ded138737e373b33f6d1970f981fd69c293 | Since 1949, the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest has hosted over 1,000 research projects covering a variety of topics and studies.

https://www.mkrf.forestry.ubc.ca/ | 9f6445827707363e96489ec15c643ded138737e373b33f6d1970f981fd69c293 | Help Shape the Future of Outdoor Recreation at Loon Lake: Discover the new high and low ropes course coming in 2027 and learn about the opportunity to become Loon Lake’s recreational programming partner.

https://www.mkrf.forestry.ubc.ca/ | 9f6445827707363e96489ec15c643ded138737e373b33f6d1970f981fd69c293 | News & Events; Teen Summer Camps with Wild & Immersive!; Forest Tour! 77 Years of Research at the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest

https://www.mkrf.forestry.ubc.ca/ | 9f6445827707363e96489ec15c643ded138737e373b33f6d1970f981fd69c293 | Trail Maps: View our trail maps. Copies can also be picked up at the research forest office during office hours.

https://www.mkrf.forestry.ubc.ca/ | 9f6445827707363e96489ec15c643ded138737e373b33f6d1970f981fd69c293 | Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre: A Nature based destination for corporate retreats, wellness weekends and youth school groups. Wild & Immersive: Outdoor learning programs rooted in nature for youth and adults.

rules.rationale: These named homepage items invite a programming partner and participation in teen summer camps.
rules.title_pattern: ^(?:Help Shape the Future of Outdoor Recreation at Loon Lake|Teen Summer Camps)\b

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly labels News & Events and advertises a dated forest research tour as an event announcement.
Trail maps provide practical visitor help, and the lodge section describes retreat facilities and services.
Wild & Immersive is explicitly described as outdoor learning programs for youth and adults.

fallback.rationale: The institutional host is the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest, described as a site supporting over 1,000 research projects since 1949.
